feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Suspected far-right activists from Britain 'with tear gas bombs' detained in France
articles.summary: Five suspected far-right activists from Britain were detained in northern France last Thursday, according to authorities.

articles.title: Former Ireland European 1,500m champion dies at age of 34
articles.summary: Former European 1,500m champion Ciara Mageean has died at the age of 34.

articles.title: The King to speak about slavery with 'unflinching honesty'
articles.summary: The King will speak about slavery with "unflinching honesty" and "sincere sorrow" in a speech to Commonwealth leaders amid increasing pressure for Britain to offer an apology over its role in the transatlantic slave trade.

articles.title: UN demands investigation into death of staff member in Houthi custody
articles.summary: A Yemeni staff member of the UN Human Rights Office has died in Houthi custody after being arbitrarily held for more ​than two years, the UN human rights chief has said.

articles.title: Judge dismisses Trump's Wall Street Journal lawsuit
articles.summary: A US judge has dismissed President Donald Trump's lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal over a story about a birthday card he allegedly sent Jeffrey Epstein.

articles.title: Majority of funds stolen in cryptocurrency hack replenished, Binance says
articles.summary: Around 90% of stolen cryptocurrency assets following a hack on a major exchange has been replenished, according to Binance.

articles.title: Man dies and another injured after attack at centre housing migrants
articles.summary: A man has died following an attack at a centre housing migrants in Ireland.

articles.title: Ebola outbreak kills more than 5,000 people in Democratic Republic of Congo
articles.summary: More than 5,000 people have now died from an Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), according to government data.

articles.title: G20 photocall axed after Miliband and other ministers refuse to be pictured with top Russian diplomat
articles.summary: A photocall of foreign ministers was cancelled by the US after the UK's Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband and other European counterparts refused to be pictured with Russia's envoy Sergei Lavrov.
